# opnsense_nginx_ip_acl (Resource)

nginx IP access lists (**Services ▸ Nginx ▸ Configuration ▸ Access ▸ IP ACLs**, plugin `os-nginx`), used by HTTP servers, locations and stream servers. Entries are evaluated in order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_nginx_ip_acl" "office" {
  description    = "office"
  default_action = "deny"
  entries = [
    { network = "10.0.0.0/8", action = "allow" },
    { network = "192.168.0.0/16", action = "allow" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Name of the ACL, shown in the drop-downs.
- `entries` (Attributes List) ACL entries, in order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))

### Optional

- `default_action` (String) Action for clients matching no entry: `deny`, `allow`, or empty for none. Defaults to `""`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the ACL.

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Required:

- `action` (String) `allow` or `deny`.
- `network` (String) Address or network, e.g. `10.0.0.0/8`.
